header: Formatted text at a readable line length
bodytext:
This is the element editors write into. Subheadings, lists, links and emphasis from the rich text editor get the page's spacing automatically. The column stops at 70 characters, so every line stays easy to read.

Headings inside start one level down

The element's title is the heading above. Headings the editor adds sit below it, so a long page keeps a clear outline.

  • Lists use the body text size and their own indent
  • Links use the accent colour and an underline
  • Emphasis uses the theme's semibold weight, not a second typeface

The element adds no styles of its own. A shared text style does the work, so one theme change reaches every paragraph at once.
